Look-alike penalties, point values and time windows from the license-action pages, each tied to one handbook page; hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec19-R01 | anchor: A01
Two or more DUI convictions bring revocation, while two or more reckless driving or racing convictions bring suspension. [A01]
Why it matters: group revocation versus suspension; difficulty three; confusable sec19-F05 versus sec19-F08.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec19-R02 | anchor: A01
Repeat reckless driving or racing convictions bring a suspension, which is only a temporary removal of the privilege. [A01]
Why it matters: group revocation versus suspension; difficulty two; confusable sec19-F15 versus sec19-F01.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec19-R03 | anchor: A01
The points threshold for Traffic Survival School is 8 or more points, counted inside any 12-month period. [A01]
Why it matters: group points; difficulty three; prereq sec19-F18.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec19-R04 | anchor: A02
Leaving the scene of a crash and a failure to stop or yield that causes death each carry 6 points, while the same failure causing serious injury carries 4 points. [A02]
Why it matters: group points; difficulty three; confusable sec19-F20 versus sec19-F21 versus sec19-F22.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec19-R05 | anchor: A02
Speeding and gore-area violations each carry 3 points, while wrong-way driving and all other moving violations carry 2 points. [A02]
Why it matters: group points; difficulty two; confusable sec19-F23 versus sec19-F25.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec19-R06 | anchor: A02
A first chemical test refusal brings a 12-month suspension, while a second or later refusal within 7 years brings 2 years. [A02]
Why it matters: group chemical test; difficulty three; prereq sec19-F31.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec19-R07 | anchor: A02
Wrong-way driving appears both as a 2-point violation and, on a controlled-access highway, as a ground for MVD action. [A02]
Why it matters: group wrong-way driving; difficulty two; confusable sec19-F25 versus sec19-F41.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec19-R08 | anchor: A03
Financial responsibility suspensions rise from 3 months for a first violation to 6 months and then 1 year for repeat violations within 36 months. [A03]
Why it matters: group insurance; difficulty three; confusable sec19-F45 versus sec19-F46 versus sec19-F47.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec19-R09 | anchor: A03
Being cited for driving while suspended can mean an impound of up to 30 days, while being convicted of it can make you eligible for a restricted license. [A03]
Why it matters: group suspended driving; difficulty three; confusable sec19-F43 versus sec19-F44.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec19-R10 | anchor: A03
Missing court or not paying a criminal traffic charge suspends the license, while delinquent traffic fines also block vehicle registration renewal. [A03]
Why it matters: group court; difficulty two; confusable sec19-F48 versus sec19-F51.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec19-R11 | anchor: A03
Drivers under 18 can be suspended for failing any court order, not only for missing court or not paying a fine. [A03]
Why it matters: group young drivers; difficulty two; prereq sec19-F50.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0064]
